questions.prompt: Which race has drawn more outside money so far in the general election?
Can a super PAC give $10,000 directly to a House candidate's campaign?
questions.why: Super PACs can raise unlimited money but can't give to candidates or coordinate with them. They can only spend independently.

questions.prompt: Groups helping Democrats have spent $292K in IN's 1st District House race. Are Democrats playing offense or defense?
questions.why: Democrats hold this seat now, so money helping Democrats here is defense.

questions.prompt: Can a corporation give directly to a candidate's campaign?
questions.why: Corporations and unions can't contribute to federal candidates. They can form PACs, or give to super PACs.

questions.prompt: After NRSC v. FEC (June 2026), how much can a party spend in coordination with its Senate nominee?
options: Up to a set limit per state
questions.why: The Supreme Court struck down the limits on party coordinated spending, so parties can now spend without limit alongside their candidates.
